title: Add Streaming Support for OpenAI o1 Model in streamText
body:
### Feature Description

Hi, OpenAI has recently announced streaming support for the o1 model. However, the streamText function currently does not work with o1, and we have to use smoothStream as a workaround to simulate streaming.

It would be great to add native support for o1 streaming in streamText, ensuring a seamless real-time experience without requiring additional modifications.

Is this feature planned for an update? Looking forward to your thoughts. Thanks! 🚀
